mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% within 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within 2 months signals a weakening supply side, which may lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% for 3 consecutive months) signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2.5% year-over-year and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the same period, it signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5% and PAYEMS increase > 200k
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% year-over-year, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the same period, signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
